title: Buffer over-read in PostgreSQL dict_int allows a database user to disclose portions of server… (CVE-2026-116308)
description: A buffer over-read vulnerability exists in the PostgreSQL dict_int module that allows a database user to disclose portions of server memory by using a zero-length token. This issue affects PostgreSQL versions prior to 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.3.
